verdict.rationale: Letta's memory is file-based. Memory entries become Markdown files in a MemFS repository, shared memory gives agents access to the same files, and an optional MemFS Search mod adds keyword, semantic or hybrid search for recall. Image attachments appear only in a mobile demo's chat interface, with nothing showing they persist as memory. Missing for 10: documented ingestion of images, PDFs or arbitrary binary files into memory, extraction of their content for later recall, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
